versionNotes: The official PHP 8.5.9 release was current on the audit date.
str_increment and str_decrement entered PHP in 8.3.
mb_trim, mb_ltrim, mb_rtrim, mb_lcfirst, mb_ucfirst, and grapheme_str_split entered PHP in 8.4.
grapheme_levenshtein entered PHP in 8.5; the Grapheme Functions table of contents had not yet listed it on the audit date, so the official 8.5 release announcement closes that catalogue lag.

sources.title: PHP: Grapheme Functions - Manual; PHP 8.5 Release Announcement

intlBoundaryReviews.finding: Explicit normalization is unresolved between String and a Unicode domain; ordinary String operations remain non-normalizing.
Locale-aware collation belongs outside locale-independent lexical String comparison.
General transliteration belongs to a specialized Unicode/text domain, not the minimal String companion.
Grapheme boundaries are core; word, sentence, and line boundaries require a future text-segmentation owner.
Unicode scalar metadata belongs to a future Unicode domain rather than String.
Encoding conversion belongs at the Bytes-to-text boundary with explicit encodings and failure policy.
